criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve assigned handoff needs through coverage mapping
avoid generic keyword matching when assigning coverage
keep missing capability coverage visible as unsupported

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the bounded handoff records and marks direct coverage only when an exact need matches a supplied capability; unsupported records remain visible for n06-r01 and n06-r07.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs ahead of covered needs
use provenance rank for within-group ordering
preserve contradictory or missing demand coverage rather than hiding it

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs ranks unsupported needs before directly covered needs and uses upstream provenance rank as the within-group ordering key, matching the declared downstream role and final priority order.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation keeps the bounded eight-row priority window and derives the recommendation directly from the first ranked priority, producing the required deterministic top_need and decision.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: select demanded corpus records from supplied input
retain explicit fallback records through returned data path
observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes establish customer demand

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records selects all demanded corpus records in the supplied bounded input and retains fallback records through the returned path; no unrelated or generic keyword-only candidates are introduced by this boundary.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: use neutral JSON-safe sentinels for missing fields
avoid converting missing evidence into demand claims

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence keeps only the allowed record window, fills missing values with neutral sentinels, and preserves the supplied record identifiers for downstream handoff.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: assemble record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance creates one provenance row per normalized need and ranks records deterministically by demand score and record_id, producing the exact evidence_sources handoff consumed downstream.
